title: ProcessPrefBench: Evaluating Cross-Task Transfer of Individual Process Preferences from Naturalistic Human-AI Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2611.06065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In natural human-AI dialogue, users' corrections, requests, and self-descriptions carry reusable signals about how they want work to be done. These signals reveal individual process preferences, user-specific standards for evidence, depth, analytical focus, procedure, and delivery. We ask whether a preference revealed in one dialogue can shape an assistant's later answer when the task does not restate it. ProcessPrefBench uses three months of natural dialogues from two knowledge workers to build 66 source-target cases separately judged for source evidence and target applicability. Sources are preselected, so the benchmark tests application rather than retrieval. We test three models with target-only, full-history, and distilled-preference prompts. Target-specific 0-2 rubrics score preference realization, and a task gate flags severe failures. Compared with target-only prompting, full-history and imperative distilled-preference prompting

translated_title: ProcessPrefBench：评估自然人机交互中个体过程偏好的跨任务迁移
translated_abstract: 在自然人机对话中，用户的纠正、请求和自我描述携带着关于他们希望工作如何完成的可复用信号。这些信号揭示了个体过程偏好，即用户在证据、深度、分析焦点、流程和交付方式方面的个性化标准。我们探讨在一段对话中显现的偏好，能否在后续任务未重申该偏好的情况下，塑造助手后续的回答。ProcessPrefBench 使用两位知识工作者三个月的自然对话，构建了 66 个源-目标案例，并对源证据和目标适用性分别进行评判。由于源案例经过预选，该基准测试的是偏好的应用而非检索。我们使用仅目标、完整历史和提炼偏好三种提示词测试了三个模型。针对目标的具体 0-2 分评分量表对偏好实现程度进行打分，并通过任务门槛标记严重失败。与仅目标提示相比，完整历史和指令式提炼偏好提示……
tldr: 提出 ProcessPrefBench 基准，基于两位知识工作者三个月的自然人机对话构建 66 个源-目标案例，评估个体过程偏好能否跨任务迁移以塑造 AI 助手后续回答，并发现完整历史与提炼偏好提示优于仅目标提示。
en_tdlr: Proposes ProcessPrefBench, a benchmark built from three months of naturalistic human-AI dialogues with 66 source-target cases, to evaluate whether individual process preferences transfer across tasks to shape later AI responses, showing that full-history and distilled-preference prompting outperform target-only prompting.
